description: Check up to 50 web requests at once, for example the unique user agent and address pairs from an access log, and learn for each whether it really comes from the AI agent or crawler its user agent names. Same checks as identify_request; results come back in the order sent, by index. Remove duplicates before sending. Send no paths: to check robots.txt, apply its rules yourself. To check a whole log without sending it, download https://whoreadsthe.com/check/data.json and follow the rules at https://whoreadsthe.com/api#local. What you send is used for the check and is not stored.

requests.description: The requests to check: each a User-Agent header value and the IPv4 or IPv6 address it came from.

name: check_requests
title: Check many web requests
